content.introduction: According to the sources, Coinbase's net income surged 66% in the third quarter, driven by bitcoin investment gains. Amazon AWS reported 39% revenue growth, while Intel's stock plunged 21% due to weak guidance attributed to a PC slowdown. Amazon also posted a negative free cash flow of $42.4 billion but kept its 2026 capital expenditures unchanged. CNBC's earnings section also mentions a significant reversal in stock performance and various other earnings reports, but specific details beyond these are not provided.
